title: works-community pack
description: One data/works-community/<dir>/<pack>.json file: the CC BY-SA characters and recaps sidecars keyed by work slug. A separate family from works/ so the license boundary is directory-structural as well as schema-structural; every entry is share-alike by the sidecar schemas' license lock.

entries.description: The pack's entries, keyed by work slug. Canonical formatting sorts them, so the file is always in slug order.

additionalProperties.description: One work's community sidecars. Either member may be absent; an entry carrying neither is not an entry.
